decision.critic: All estimates are model predictions, not measurements. They span only 3.571 to 3.609, and the uncertainties (0.08 to 0.14) exceed those gaps, so the ranking is weak.
decision.selection_rationale: C32 has the highest estimate (3.609) and the lowest uncertainty (0.084). C31, C16 and C35 follow at about 3.572 to 3.577. C05 ranks fifth, ahead of C41, because both have the same estimate and C05 adds a different E17K substitution.
